title: Report: GameSpot Details Xbox Region Trick to Play GTA 6 Early
description: GameSpot details an Xbox region-change trick that may let players access GTA 6 in New Zealand time before the U.S. launch, with caveats about Microsoft policy and no guarantee of success.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Xbox New Zealand Region Trick: Play Before US Launch
socialHook: GameSpot says Xbox players can switch their console region to New Zealand to try playing GTA 6 early.

sections.heading: GameSpot Reports Xbox Region Trick for GTA 6
paragraphs: GameSpot reports that because Grand Theft Auto 6 does not release simultaneously worldwide, players in New Zealand will be first to play at midnight local time on November 19. The outlet outlines an Xbox trick: go to Settings, select System, then Language & Localization, switch the location to New Zealand, and restart the console. GameSpot cautions that the method has worked before but carries no guarantee for GTA 6, and Microsoft’s policy states users should only change regions after moving to a new country.

sections.heading: Timing, PlayStation Risks, and Unknowns
paragraphs: Midnight in New Zealand on November 19 equals 3 AM PT and 6 AM ET on November 18, meaning U.S. players face a long wait. GameSpot notes the PlayStation 5 process is less straightforward and cites Insider Gaming’s rundown, alongside reports that some PS5 users changing regions have received account suspensions without warning. GameSpot offers no guarantee the Xbox trick will work for GTA 6 and reminds readers that Microsoft’s policy limits region changes to people who have moved to a new country.
